info.title: Secure Password Manager API
info.description:
OpenAPI 3.1 specification for the Secure Password Manager.

Envelope convention: Every response body is wrapped in a header/body envelope
(inspired by Passbolt — ADR-001 section 8, adapted). The header block carries
transport metadata; the body block carries the entity payload.

Status codes: status is a human-readable string (success, error, warning).
code is a machine-readable integer (200-class success, 400-class client error,
500-class server error). The HTTP status line mirrors code.

UUIDs: All entity IDs are UUID v4, serialized as RFC 4122 strings.
No auto-increment integers, no sequential IDs (ADR-001 section 8; ADR-003 section 5).

Soft delete: Every entity has a deleted boolean. The API filters
deleted=false by default on all list endpoints. includeDeleted=true shows
soft-deleted items (owner-only, authorization-checked). Hard deletes not exposed.

Pagination: Cursor-based via page[after], page[before], page[size].
Offset/limit rejected in favor of cursors (original decision).

Filtering: filter[] query parameters provide search/filter semantics
(inspired by Passbolt — ADR-001 section 8, adapted). Each entry is field:op:value.

Include (eager loading): include[] query parameters control related entities
(inspired by Passbolt contain[] — ADR-001 section 8, renamed to include[] as
an original naming choice). Omitting returns minimal payload.

Authorization: Every endpoint requires valid JWT in Authorization: Bearer header.
Authorization checks centralized in API layer (ADR-002 section 3.2; ADR-003 section 6).

Passbolt vs. original: Each major contract decision flagged inline with
PASSBOLT-INSPIRED or ORIGINAL comments. See ADR-001 for inspired patterns;
ADR-003 section 8 for data-model flagging.

tags.name: Groups
tags.description: Group containers (post-MVP; schema defined, endpoints deferred)

id.description: Unique ID for this response (UUID v4). Useful for tracing.

servertime.description: Server timestamp (UTC) when the response was generated.

action.description:
The action that produced this response (e.g. ListResources,
CreateResource, Authenticate). Mirrors the operation name.

message.description: Human-readable message. Empty on success; descriptive on error.

url.description: Optional URL related to the response.

code.description: Machine-readable status code. Mirrors the HTTP status line.

body.description:
The entity payload. Shape depends on the action. For list endpoints, body
contains the paginated collection. For single-entity endpoints, body contains
the entity object. The envelope is transparent to the entity shape.

documentationUrl.description: Link to API documentation for this error class.

code.description:
Machine-readable error code (e.g. VALIDATION_ERROR,
NOT_FOUND, FORBIDDEN, UNAUTHORIZED).

field.description: The field or parameter that caused the error.

after.description: Opaque cursor — ID of last item on current page.

before.description: Opaque cursor — ID of first item on current page.

size.description: Number of items returned in this page.

total.description: Total number of items matching the query.

deleted.description: Soft-delete flag. List endpoints filter deleted=false by default.

PermissionSummary.description: Compact permission representation for folder masks and inline listings.

level.description:
read (1): View metadata + secret. Cannot edit, delete, or manage permissions.
update (7): Read + edit metadata/secret + delete. Cannot manage permissions.
owner (15): Update + manage permissions + transfer ownership.
Numeric values preserved from Passbolt for conceptual continuity; stored as enum.

granteeType.description: User or group grantee (group-as-ARO, ADR-001 section 4).

granteeId.description: UUID v4 of the User or Group that holds this permission.

email.description:
Unique email address. Plaintext in DB — used for lookup,
not a secret (ADR-003 section 3.1 note).

username.description: Unique human-readable handle. Plaintext in DB.

salt.description: Base64-encoded CSPRNG salt (16+ bytes). Never transmitted.

kdfParams.description:
Argon2id parameters (version, memoryCost, timeCost, parallelism).
Never transmitted to clients.

vaultKeyEncrypted.description:
Base64-encoded AEAD-encrypted vault key. Never plaintext.
The plaintext vault key is never in the DB (ADR-003 section 3.1; SEC-001).

mfaSecret.description: Base32-encoded TOTP secret. null if MFA not enabled.

settings.description: User preferences (theme, auto-lock timeout). Plaintext, non-secret.

ownerId.description: UUID v4 of the User who owns this vault. 1:1 with User in MVP.

version.description:
Schema/format version for vault contents. Default 1.
Original decision (ADR-003 section 8.2 item 4).

vaultId.description: UUID v4 of the Vault this resource belongs to.

ownerId.description: UUID v4 of the User who created this resource.

name.description: Required. Human-readable label (e.g. GitHub, Work Email).

username.description:
Username/email for this login. Plaintext metadata.
Optional. May be encrypted if metadataEncrypted=true.

uri.description:
Website/app URL. Plaintext metadata. Optional.
May be encrypted if metadataEncrypted=true.

description.description:
User notes. Plaintext metadata. Optional.
May be encrypted if metadataEncrypted=true.

type.description:
Resource type identifier. Fixed set in V1: password-and-description,
username-password-uri. Extensible later (ADR-001 section 1).

secretCiphertext.description:
Base64-encoded AEAD-encrypted secret payload.
NEVER plaintext in DB. Client decrypts with vault key (ADR-002 section 4.3).

metadataEncrypted.description:
Whether metadata fields are encrypted. Default false for MVP.
When true, metadataCiphertext holds encrypted blob.
Per-resource opt-in (ADR-001 section 1; ADR-003 section 8.2 item 2).
ORIGINAL granularity.

metadataCiphertext.description: Base64-encoded encrypted metadata blob. Present only when metadataEncrypted=true.

favorite.description:
User-designated favorite. Simple boolean flag in V1.
ORIGINAL inclusion (ADR-003 section 8.2 item 3).

folderId.description: UUID v4 of the Folder. null = vault root. Optional.

tagIds.description: UUID v4 array of Tag IDs. Representation resolved by BE-001a.

permissionIds.description: UUID v4 array of Permission IDs. Logical model ADR-003 section 3.5.

vaultId.description: UUID v4 of the Vault this folder belongs to.

ownerId.description: UUID v4 of the User who created this folder.

parentId.description: UUID v4 of parent Folder. null = root level. Optional.

icon.description: Optional icon identifier for UI. Non-secret metadata. Optional.

color.description: Optional color hex for UI. Non-secret metadata. Optional.

permissionMask.description:
Permission applied to resources at create/move time (ADR-001 section 2).
Where possible propagation — only resources the user has Owner permission
on are affected. API implements propagation; no continuous enforcement.
See ADR-003 section 3.4 and section 6.3.

vaultId.description: UUID v4 of the Vault. Tags scoped to a vault (ADR-003 section 3.6).

color.description: Optional display color. Non-secret metadata. Optional.

targetType.description: Type of entity this permission applies to.

targetId.description: UUID v4 of the target entity.

granteeType.description: User or group grantee (group-as-ARO, ADR-001 section 4).

granteeId.description: UUID v4 of the User or Group that holds this permission.

grantedBy.description: UUID v4 of the User who granted this permission.

ownerId.description: UUID v4 of the User who created the group.

status.description: Always "ok" when the service is healthy.

PageAfter.name: page[after]
PageAfter.description: Cursor — ID of last item on current page. Pass to get next page.

PageBefore.name: page[before]
PageBefore.description: Cursor — ID of first item on current page. Pass to get previous page.

PageSize.name: page[size]
PageSize.description: Number of items per page. Max 100.

IncludeRelations.name: include[]
IncludeRelations.description:
Eager-load related entities. Repeatable. Available includes documented per endpoint.
PASSBOLT-INSPIRED (ADR-001 section 8): Passbolt uses contain[] for eager loading.
ORIGINAL: we rename to include[] as a naming preference; same concept.
Available include keys: permissions, folder, tags, owner, group.

Filter.name: filter[]
Filter.description:
Search/filter parameters. Repeatable. Each entry is field:op:value.
PASSBOLT-INSPIRED (ADR-001 section 8): Passbolt uses filter[] for search/filter.
ORIGINAL: we define our own operator set and field names.
Common operators: eq (exact match), contains (substring, case-insensitive),
gt/gte/lt/lte (comparison), in (value in set), null/notNull (null check).
Example: filter[]=name:contains:Git&filter[]=type:eq:username-password-uri

IncludeDeleted.name: includeDeleted
IncludeDeleted.description:
When true, include soft-deleted entities in list responses. Default false.
Authorization-checked — only owner (or users with Owner permission) can see
their own soft-deleted items.

BearerAuth.description:
JWT access token issued on login/unlock. Short-lived. Refresh token rotation
handled separately. Token carries user ID, validated on every request
(ADR-002 section 3.2; ADR-003 section 6.2).

post.description:
Exchange master password for a JWT session. Client derives vault key locally via
KDF (Argon2id), then sends encrypted vault key to server for verification.
Server never sees master password or plaintext vault key (SEC-001; ADR-002 section 4.2).
PASSBOLT-INSPIRED (ADR-001 section 7): authentication flow concept.
ORIGINAL: master password + KDF to vault key, not OpenPGP/GPGAuth. No server identity challenge.

vaultKeyProof.description:
Base64-encoded ciphertext proving the client holds the vault key.
Exact construction defined by SEC-001 / BE-002a.

mfaCode.description: TOTP code if MFA enabled. Optional.

200.description: Login successful. Returns JWT access + refresh tokens.

post.description:
Exchange valid refresh token for new access token. Refresh token rotation enforced —
old token invalidated on use (ADR-002 section 4.2).

refreshToken.description: Valid refresh token from previous login or refresh.

post.description: Invalidate access + refresh token pair. Client clears local vault key from memory.

get.description:
List all users. Restricted to admin/owner contexts. Not in MVP scope.
MVP: user can only see their own record.

Get single user record. Requester must be the user themselves (or admin in post-MVP).
salt, kdfParams, vaultKeyEncrypted never returned — server-side only.

List vaults accessible to authenticated user. MVP: exactly one vault per user (1:1).
Filtered to user's own vault by default. Authorization-checked.
PASSBOLT-INSPIRED (ADR-001 section 8): envelope + pagination conventions.
ORIGINAL: Vault as explicit container separate from User (ADR-003 section 3.2;
  ADR-003 section 8.2 item 1).

Get single vault. Authorization-checked — user must have at least Read access
(ownership or explicit permission).

List resources in authenticated user's vault. Filtered by vault + authorization.
Soft-deleted excluded unless includeDeleted=true.

post.description:
Create resource in authenticated user's vault. secretCiphertext must be encrypted
client-side with vault key before submission. Server never sees plaintext secret
(ADR-002 section 4.3; SEC-001).
PASSBOLT-INSPIRED (ADR-001 section 1): resource/secret split — client encrypts
secret payload, sends only ciphertext.
ORIGINAL: AEAD construction (not OpenPGP); metadata encryption opt-in per-resource from V1.
If folderId provided, folder permissionMask applied where possible (ADR-001 section 2;
  ADR-003 section 6.3).

type.description: Resource type. Fixed set in V1.

metadataEncrypted.description: Whether to encrypt metadata fields. Default false.

metadataCiphertext.description: Required if metadataEncrypted=true. Base64-encoded encrypted metadata.

folderId.description: Optional. Folder to place resource in.

get.description:
Get single resource. Authorization-checked. If metadataEncrypted=true, plaintext
metadata fields absent — client decrypts metadataCiphertext with vault key.
secretCiphertext always returned for client-side decryption.

patch.description:
Partially update resource. Only provided fields updated. Client re-encrypts
secretCiphertext (and metadataCiphertext if metadataEncrypted changing) before submission.
Authorization-checked — requires Update permission or ownership (ADR-003 section 6.2).
If folderId changed, folder permissionMask applied at move time (ADR-001 section 2).

schema.description: Partial update. Any subset of Resource fields may be provided.

delete.description:
Soft-delete (sets deleted=true). Hard deletes not exposed.
Authorization-checked — requires Update permission or ownership.

get.description:
List folders in authenticated user's vault. Returns folder tree (parentId preserved).
Authorization-checked.

post.description:
Create folder in authenticated user's vault. parentId optional — omit for root-level.
permissionMask set on create, updatable later. Authorization-checked — creator is owner.
PASSBOLT-INSPIRED (ADR-001 section 2): folder hierarchy with permission mask.
ORIGINAL: three-level permission model, Folder.permissionMask field, API implements
  propagation (ADR-003 section 3.4).

parentId.description: Optional. Parent folder ID. null = root level.

patch.description:
Partial update. Authorization-checked — requires Update permission or ownership.
permissionMask updatable at any time; changes apply to new create/move operations only.

delete.description:
Soft-delete (sets deleted=true). Resources in folder NOT automatically deleted —
they become root-level (folderId set to null). Authorization-checked.

get.description:
List tags in authenticated user's vault. Tags scoped to vault (ADR-003 section 3.6).
Authorization-checked.
PASSBOLT-INSPIRED (ADR-001 section 3): flat, non-hierarchical tags, many-to-many.
ORIGINAL: tags scoped to vault (ADR-003 section 8.2).

post.description:
Create tag in authenticated user's vault. Tag names unique within vault
(case-insensitive). Authorization-checked — vault owner owns all tags.

delete.description:
Soft-delete tag. Decrements tag reference count on resources.
Authorization-checked.

get.description:
List permission grants accessible to authenticated user. Filtered by user's
ownership and group membership. Authorization-checked.

post.description:
Grant permission to user or group on resource, folder, or vault.
Authorization-checked — grantor must have Owner-level access to target
(ADR-003 section 6.2). Group grants use group-as-ARO model (ADR-001 section 4).
PASSBOLT-INSPIRED (ADR-001 section 4, section 5): permission grant concept,
  group-as-ARO.
ORIGINAL: Permission.id as UUID primary key — each grant is a row
  (ADR-003 section 8.2 item 7). Numeric values preserved for continuity
  but stored as enum.

403.description: Not authorized to grant permission on this target.

delete.description:
Revoke permission grant. Authorization-checked — revoker must have Owner-level
access to target, or be original grantor.

403.description: Not authorized to revoke this permission.

get.description:
POST-MVP. Listed for contract completeness only. Not available in V1.
Schema defined in ADR-003 section 3.7; implementation deferred to Phase 4.

post.description: POST-MVP. Not available in V1. Schema defined in ADR-003 section 3.7.

get.description: Liveness/readiness probe. Not part of the versioned /api/v1 contract; served at the root alongside the OpenAPI document. No authorization required.
The OpenAPI 3.1 document for this API (this file).
